description: Unit tests for QuicCoalescedPacket class, testing packet coalescing, buffer copying, and initial packet neutering.

classes.name: QuicCoalescedPacket
classes.description: Class representing a coalesced packet in QUIC, supporting coalescing, buffer copying, and neutering initial packets.

methods.name: MaybeCoalescePacket
methods.description: Attempts to coalesce a serialized packet into the current coalesced packet, considering size and address compatibility.

methods.name: CopyEncryptedBuffers
methods.description: Copies the encrypted buffers from the coalesced packet into a provided buffer.

methods.name: NeuterInitialPacket
methods.description: Resets the coalesced packet to remove the initial packet, clearing relevant state.
